svg.title: 09 · ActivityPub S2S Federation, 3-Tier Trust & Cross-Instance Lending
svg.desc: Modern Athenaeum architecture diagram for iqoqo v1.1.1 showing Node A local discovery, RSA-2048 Fernet key storage, outbound Valkey federation queue, Node B inbound HTTP Signature gate, 3-tier unilateral trust matrix, and 4-step peer-to-peer lending sequence.
svg.text: 09 · ActivityPub S2S Federation, 3-Tier Trust & Cross-Instance Lending
iqoqo v1.1.1 • Server-to-Server Only (No C2S), HTTP Signatures, Unilateral Trust Graph & CIDOC CRM Custody

g.text: • RSA-2048 private keys encrypted at rest with symmetric Fernet (SECRET_KEY)
• Exposes publicKeyPem + SHA256:... DER key fingerprints in Admin UI
• Signs outbound POST & Authorized Fetch GET via draft-cavage-http-signatures-12
• FEDERATION_ALLOW_LOOPBACK=true permitted only in local dev pair tests
User Consent & Read-Only Showcase Hub Mode
• User shelf never federates unless explicitly opted in via /profile
Allows federated catalog discovery & wishlists; rejects physical Item writes (HTTP 403)
1. Verifies RSA-SHA256 HTTP Signature against dereferenced actor publicKeyPem
2. ±300s clock-skew replay defense + strict payload_actor == actor_uri check
3. Evaluates local FederationInstance.trust_level (blocked dropped at gate)
4. Sanitizes all inbound bibliographic metadata via bleach.clean()
5. Enqueues verified activity onto local Celery worker for SHACL-validated sync
Evaluated unilaterally by each instance's local policy (peering is asymmetric by default):
Catalog Sync, Follows & Cross-Instance Loan Policy
• Auto SHACL-validated catalog sync (local curator locks always win)
• Direct Follow delivery & Cross-Instance Loans enabled
Unilateral Outbound: Enriches local catalog; peer policy governs loans
• Public catalog discovery only; NO automatic catalog synchronization
• Inbound Follow & Loan requests held for manual custodian review
• Rejected immediately at HTTP Signature gate
• Follow requests, catalog sync & loan offers dropped silently

svg.text: Cross-Instance Peer-to-Peer Lending Sequence (CIDOC CRM Custody)

g.text: • Clicks Request Loan on item view
Node B → Signed Accept → Node A
• Appears as Borrowed on Node A
